visualCharacteristics: Horizontal tab strip with bold labels above a bordered content panel; the selected tab merges into the panel below it. Panels hold rich content (paragraphs, sub-headings, images, bulleted lists). Only the active panel is visible.
contentPattern: Repeating rows, each a tab: cell 1 is the tab label (e.g. 'Overview'), cell 2 is the panel content.
usage: Adventure detail body split into switchable panels such as Overview, Itinerary, and What to Bring.
